historical_commentary.text: This note documents the 4D DAV plug-in, a cURL-based component adding WebDAV client commands to 4D 2004 for file transfer, locking, and collaboration with WebDAV servers, including Apple's now-defunct iDisk/.Mac service. WebDAV as a protocol is still used in some enterprise and cloud-storage contexts, but Apple's iDisk was shut down years ago, and this specific plug-in and its 2006-era demo client are tied to a 4D plug-in architecture and library version long superseded by modern 4D networking and cloud-integration options.
related_updates: Apple's iDisk/.Mac service referenced in this note was discontinued long ago
4D has since expanded native HTTP/network commands, reducing reliance on specialized plug-ins like 4D DAV for this kind of file-transfer integration
